description: Information about models and individuals from which biospecimen(s) were collected.

DaystoTreatment.description: Number of days between the date used for index and the date the treatment started.
DaystoTreatment.title: Days to Treatment

DiseaseType.description: The type of tumor associated with the individual, biospecimen, or model. Multiple values permitted, comma separated.
DiseaseType.title: Disease Type

ICD-10-CMDiseaseCode.description: An alphanumeric value from the tenth version of the International Classification of Disease (ICD-10-CM) used to identify the diagnosis (e.g. C80.1). Reference-validated against the ICD-10-CM code system, not a fixed list.
ICD-10-CMDiseaseCode.title: ICD-10-CM Disease Code

IndividualAge90orOlder.description: The response to indicate whether an individual is age 90 or older.
IndividualAge90orOlder.title: Individual Age 90 or Older

IndividualAgeatDiagnosis.description: Age at the time the individual was diagnosed, expressed in years. Note: the CRDC-required CDE for this concept (Subject Age At Diagnosis, CDE 10609539) expresses this value in days rather than years; a documented days<->years derivation is implemented at the mapping/ETL layer for CRDC submission, not as a separate stored field.
IndividualAgeatDiagnosis.title: Individual Age at Diagnosis

IndividualDaysToRecurrence.description: Number of days between the date used for index and the date the patient's disease recurred
IndividualDaysToRecurrence.title: Individual Days To Recurrence

IndividualDaystoLastFollowup.description: Number of days between the dates used for index and last follow-up
IndividualDaystoLastFollowup.title: Individual Days to Last Followup

IndividualDaystoLastKnownDiseaseStatus.description: Time interval from the date of last follow up to the date of initial pathologic diagnosis, represented as a calculated number of days.
IndividualDaystoLastKnownDiseaseStatus.title: Individual Days to Last Known Disease Status

IndividualDiseaseProgressionorRecurrence.description: A term describing the kind of worsening or return of disease that a subject is experiencing.
IndividualDiseaseProgressionorRecurrence.title: Individual Disease Progression or Recurrence Type

IndividualGender.description: Text designations that identify gender. Gender is described as the assemblage of properties that distinguish people on the basis of their societal roles. Identification of gender is based upon self-report and may come from a form, questionnaire, interview, etc.
IndividualGender.title: Individual Gender

IndividualId.description: Unique row identifier, used as a primary key for record updates. This should follow the GrantNumber-INDxxx convention unless otherwise indicated.
IndividualId.title: Individual_id

IndividualLymphNodeInvolvementAnatomicSi.description: The UBERON identifier of the organ or part of the body describing lymph node involvement in disease (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon).
IndividualLymphNodeInvolvementAnatomicSi.title: Individual Lymph Node Involvement Anatomic Site Uberon Identifier

IndividualMetastasisStage.description: Extent of the distant metastasis for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined prior to treatment.
IndividualMetastasisStage.title: Individual Metastasis Stage

IndividualPrimaryTumorStage.description: Extent of the primary cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined prior to treatment.
IndividualPrimaryTumorStage.title: Individual Primary Tumor Stage

IndividualProgressionorRecurrenceAnatomi.description: The UBERON identifier of the organ or part of the body related to the progressive or recurrent disease (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon).
IndividualProgressionorRecurrenceAnatomi.title: Individual Progression or Recurrence Anatomic Site Uberon Identifier

IndividualRecurrenceStatus.description: Yes/No/Unknown indicator to identify whether a patient has had a new tumor event after initial treatment.
IndividualRecurrenceStatus.title: Individual Recurrence Status

IndividualResidualDiseaseStatus.description: A text term describing the assessment of the presence of tumor cells remaining in the body following cancer treatment.
IndividualResidualDiseaseStatus.title: Individual Residual Disease Status

IndividualTreatmentIntentType.description: Text term to identify the reason for the administration of a treatment regimen.
IndividualTreatmentIntentType.title: Individual Treatment Intent Type

IndividualTreatmentorTherapyIndicator.description: An indicator that describes whether therapy was administered.
IndividualTreatmentorTherapyIndicator.title: Individual Treatment or Therapy Indicator

IndividualTumorLymphNodeStage.description: Extent of the regional lymph node involvement for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined prior to treatment.
IndividualTumorLymphNodeStage.title: Individual Tumor Lymph Node Stage

IndividualVitalStatus.description: Text term that describes the patient's current vital status.
IndividualVitalStatus.title: Individual Vital Status

IndividualYearofBirth.description: The 4-digit year of the subject's birth. Note: a PHI/de-identification consideration was raised and accepted for this field -- see plans/crdc_cde_integration.md.
IndividualYearofBirth.title: Individual Year of Birth

IndividualYearofDeath.description: The year of a subject's death.
IndividualYearofDeath.title: Individual Year of Death

IndividualYearofDiagnosis.description: Numeric value to represent the year of an individual's diagnosis of cancer.
IndividualYearofDiagnosis.title: Individual Year of Diagnosis

IndividualdbGaPSubjectId.description: The identifer assigned to the participant by dbGap
IndividualdbGaPSubjectId.title: Individual dbGaP Subject Id

KnownMetastasisSites.description: The UBERON identifier(s) of the anatomic site(s) of metastasis associated with the malignant disease of the individual or biospecimen donor (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon). Provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
KnownMetastasisSites.title: Known Metastasis Sites

LastKnownDiseaseStatus.description: Text term that describes the last known disease status of the individual, biospecimen donor, or model.
LastKnownDiseaseStatus.title: Last Known Disease Status

PrimaryDiagnosis.description: Text term used to describe the histologic diagnosis of the patient, biospecimen donor, or model (NCI Thesaurus concept name -- reference-validated, not a fixed list; see https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/).
PrimaryDiagnosis.title: Primary Diagnosis

PrimarySite.description: The UBERON identifier of the organ or part of the body where the disease began, i.e. the primary/original disease site (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon). Reference-validated, not a fixed list.
PrimarySite.title: Primary Site

Sex.description: Biological sex associated with the individual, biospecimen donor, or model.
Sex.title: Sex

SiteofOrigin.description: The UBERON identifier of the anatomic site of origin of the patient's, biospecimen donor's, or model's malignant disease (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon).
SiteofOrigin.title: Site of Origin

StudyKey.description: The unique Study_id foreign keys associated with the resource, found in the grant Study information. Used to group the resource with other components. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
StudyKey.title: Study Key

TherapeuticAgent.description: The name of the individual agent(s) used as part of a treatment regimen or experimental protocol (NCI Thesaurus concept name -- reference-validated, not a fixed list; see https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/).
TherapeuticAgent.title: Therapeutic Agent

TreatmentAnatomicSite.description: The UBERON identifier of the organ or part of the body targeted by a therapeutic procedure (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon).
TreatmentAnatomicSite.title: Treatment Anatomic Site

TreatmentResponse.description: Text term that describes the final outcome after a treatment was administered to the individual, biospecimen donor, or model.
TreatmentResponse.title: Treatment Response

TreatmentType.description: Text term that describes the kind of treatment administered to the individual, biospecimen donor, or model.
TreatmentType.title: Treatment Type

TumorGrade.description: Numeric value to express the degree of abnormality of cancer cells, a measure of differentiation and aggressiveness.
TumorGrade.title: Tumor Grade

TumorSubtype.description: The molecular or histologic subtype of the tumor associated with the individual, biospecimen, or model.
TumorSubtype.title: Tumor Subtype

title: Individual
